title: Vaishnavism Saints Haridas
definition: The Haridasa movement was a devotional (Bhakti) movement in Karnataka (13th–17th century) that propagated Vaishnavism through music, literature, and the philosophy of Dwaita (Dualism).
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Art & Culture (Music/Literature) and Medieval History (Bhakti movement evolution). UPSC focuses on the transition from Dasa Sahitya to Carnatic music.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Vaishnavism Saints Haridas.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
